What to find: Methods of distribution (open weights on repositories, API, cloud platforms, apps).
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Availability, Distribution, Access

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Open weights and configuration files in Hugging Face Transformers format (compatible with vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed); official managed API via Qwen Cloud (Qwen3.8-Max is the official version); also available through Qwen Studio.
quotes: This repository contains model weights and configuration files for the post-trained model in the Hugging Face Transformers format.
These artifacts are compatible with vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed, etc.
For users seeking managed, scalable inference without infrastructure maintenance, the official Qwen API service is provided by [Qwen Cloud](https://www.qwencloud.com).
